services.desc: Come and experience the euphoric Freedom of being on the waves with AR FREEDOM JETS About: We provide safe & fun Jet Ski Watersport Services with additional supplemental options to enhance the thrill of your Waverunner adventure. Please Note: Florida Law states that anyone born on Jan. 1st of 1988 or after must acquire a boater’s license before operating. Those born in 1987 or before are exempt from needing the boating license. The boat License must be on board as well as the Gov-issued photo ID. The test must be completed by all operators that need a boat license prior to arriving. Link for the Boater's Liscense can be found on the home page as well in the confirmation email after
